components: Badge/FrameType (Light, Bias, Dark, Flat, DarkFlat) + Badge/Source (Bias, Dark, Flat, Noise, External)

notes: Prototype connections cannot cross Figma pages; agents build per page, then frames are moved onto one Prototype page and wired at the end.
Spec reorder proposal rejected by owner: Algorithms (P7) stays before Light Frames (P8).
search_design_system: no reusable components in subscribed libraries (M3/SDS/Apple kits); everything local.
figma.createAutoLayout() frames get a default opaque white fill; always set fills=[] on containers. resize() on a TEXT node after textAutoResize=HEIGHT resets it to NONE; set HEIGHT after resize.
Paints from setBoundVariableForPaint with a black base sometimes render black; use the variable's resolved colour as the base colour.

Illustrations I3 (2026-09-24): Light path, Bias, Darks and Flats share one drawing: a star's rays converge onto the Pixel Grid layer of a single sensor chip (Pixel Grid -> Amplifier -> ADC), bracketed 'Layered Camera Sensor'; no image-file box. Bias highlights the ADC (read offset/noise come from the converter; there is no separate readout board). Darks highlights Pixel Grid + Amplifier (heat in both). Flats shows the optical path: an edge-of-field star partly blocked by the tube (dim corners) and dust on the filter; the divide-equals triptych was removed. Groups are named telescope/focuser/camera/filter/sensor chip/light/callouts inside each component's 'drawing' frame.

Tiles are Raw / Computed / What was removed, every tile populated in every state with a value caption from assets/flats-1/stats.json. Experiment 2 tiles show the flat itself (as shot vs dark-flat calibrated). upload_assets rejects instance-nested node ids (I..;..): upload to temp frames, copy the imageHash onto the instance's image well, delete the temps. B and C are clones of A.

Illustrations page holds only the four optical-path components (Noise & Defects, Bias, Darks, Flats). The Flats-continued, Alignment and Algorithms illustrations were removed on 2026-09-24; section agents decide whether their pages need one.

Flats-1 R7 (2026-09-24): the optical-path SVG sits in a cream bounding box (800 wide, instance rescaled to 752) with its two paragraphs; the real flat sits to its right (376 wide) with the caption 'The flat recorded by the camera'. Before/after is wrapped in a dark (surface/stage) box. Experiment 2 tiles are the LIGHT-FRAME ROI: Raw = frame divided by the flat as shot, Computed = divided by the dark-flat-calibrated flat, removed = their difference. 'What was removed' tiles are computed - raw centred on mid grey (lighter = added). The owner rewrote all Try-it prose and tile captions in frame A; B and C are clones of A with only toggle states, tile images and the two state-dependent captions changed.

Flats-1 R8 (2026-09-24): 'What was removed' is populated with the real difference in EVERY toggle state (exp1: with flat minus without; exp2: dark-flat-calibrated flat minus flat as shot). Only the Computed tile follows the switch. The exp2 difference is ~0.4 DN but clean (the raw noise cancels because both tiles divide the same frame), so on its own symmetric stretch it shows the same donut as exp1, slightly different.

Algorithms P7 (2026-09-24): built as a clone of Flats-1 frame A on page 8:10, restructured by owner direction: TopBar(Current=Algorithms) -> page head -> ink rule -> dark Try-it stage AT THE TOP (it replaces the illustration and the 440x330 problem slot; no illustration on this page) -> reading-2 (one-pixel box, five-method table, three in-depth prose sections, twenty-frame comparison in a dark box) -> BottomNav (Alignment / Light frames). Try it: two 576x576 ROITile instances (Raw = frame 3, Computed = the four-frame stack), a two-Chip group Average / Median in place of a Toggle, and a strip of four 132 px thumbnails of the input frames. ROITile image wells cannot be resized inside an instance (min-size and resize are ignored); set the well's layoutSizingVertical to FILL and resize the instance (576x676 gives a 574 px well with a two-line caption). The satellite ROI is a 2304 px crop at BIN 4 (assets/algorithms/, tools/assets/algorithms_page.py): the trail is ~28 DN over ~42 DN native noise, so at bin 1 or 2 the median only halves it; at bin 4 it removes it. B is a clone of A with the Median chip selected, the Computed image and caption changed. C is a clone of A with the Median twenty-frame tile enlarged to 576 px above the row of five (the 'click to enlarge' state).
